name: Credible by Qualifacts
short_description: Cloud-based Qualifacts EHR for large behavioral health agencies: CMHCs, CCBHCs, SUD, IDD and residential programs, with offline mobile documentation.
long_description: Credible is Qualifacts' cloud-based EHR for large agencies, which the vendor lists as community mental health centers, CCBHCs, substance use disorder, IDD, residential and integrated primary care providers, with one record covering primary care and behavioral health workflows, billing and documentation. Field staff can document on tablets and phones, including offline, and sync later. Qualifacts customer announcements describe Credible deployments with e-labs, e-prescribing and mobile tools for field-based staff, and its IDD materials list incident reporting and eMAR integration for residential support staff. Qualifacts iQ AI documentation is available, and the iQ scheduling and billing agents are currently offered on Credible. Pricing is not published; agencies get a quote.
one_liner: Cloud EHR from Qualifacts for large behavioral health agencies, with offline mobile charting for field staff.
best_for: Large community mental health centers and CCBHCs
Agencies combining behavioral health, SUD, IDD and residential services in one record
Organizations with field-based staff who document on phones or tablets without reliable internet
Qualifacts customers who want the iQ scheduling and billing agents, which are currently offered on Credible
not_for: Solo therapists and small private practices
Practices that want published pricing and self-serve sign-up
Small groups that do not need agency-level configuration or state reporting
